description: Configure Trace compliance monitoring for the selected workspace.

body.description: Per-agent Trace config (spec §5.1). May be wrapped as { agent_id, config } or sent raw.

agent_id.description: Agent to configure; omit for the org-wide default.

guardrails.description: Inline guardrails compiled into a synthesized rule pack (spec §5.1).

patterns.description: Deterministically-redactable PII (context-dependent PII like DOB is Tier-2, not inline).

blocked_phrases.description: Phrases the agent must never say.

fail_open.description: Trace down must never make a call worse, log 'unavailable' instead of blocking.

inline_timeout_ms.description: Inline budget; the in-process gate is ~14µs p99, far under this.

required_within_seconds.description: Deadline in seconds; otherwise a 2-turn default applies.

text.description: Phrase the agent must speak, e.g. an AI / recording disclosure.

trigger.description: call_start = must appear on the first agent turn.

mode.description: warn = log only (never blocks); modify = redact/inject; block = suppress; human_handoff = escalate.

rule_packs.description: Map of pack_id → { enabled, version }, e.g. { tcpa: { enabled: true } }.

name: configure_trace
title: Configure Trace
